font.reason: Neutral product/document UI (collaborative weekly-brief editor); variable weights 400-800 for h1/h2/body hierarchy, full Persian digits and ZWNJ coverage.

comps.translatedSummary: Persian weekly-brief document (هفتهٔ ۲۸ ۲۰۲۶ · گزارش هفتگی آزمایشگاه بنیان) written out by a mirrored wipe+caret, weeks sidebar on the right, comments rail on the left, six past-week entries dropping into the right rail.

rtlDecisions.why: Contained Chinese/English UI text that cannot be translated; rebuilt as a real DOM page (Page.tsx) with Persian product wording, Jalali date 19 Tir for 7/10.

rtlDecisions.what: Page layout: sidebar, comments rail, header/nav, toolbar, chevrons, undo/redo
rtlDecisions.why: Reading-order layout: weeks sidebar left->right, comments rail right->left, brand/nav start on the right, toolbar order reversed.
Mirrored around page centre (x' = W-x-w), right-aligned, bullets on the right (start side).

rtlDecisions.what: Writing wipe mask and amber caret
rtlDecisions.why: Paper mask anchored left shrinking right->left; caret rides the front moving in reading direction; li masks over-cover the bullet side by 28px as in the original.
Grows from the start (right) edge of the member name.

rtlDecisions.what: Rail entrance patch and inner amber line
rtlDecisions.why: Patch shrinks downward (vertical, kept); inner line moved to the inner edge of each mirrored rail; cues 46/54 kept so the weeks rail still goes first.
Gravity (drop from above, spring, air shadow) is physical; only the rail side changed; date sits at the row's left end.
cx mirrored (1920-cx) so title close-up and settle keep their relation; zoom/frames/easing unchanged.
Moved top-right -> top-left; tracked uppercase mono label became a plain Persian label (no letterSpacing/uppercase).

rtlDecisions.what: Latin tokens (cascade, drift, ASR, WER, CI, run-47, v2, LR schedule)
rtlDecisions.why: Technical tokens that Persian UIs keep; isolated with bdi so punctuation does not jump; digits elsewhere are Persian.
Motion fidelity requirement; text shortened so every bullet occupies the original line count (blocks 2 and 5 two lines, others one line).

rasterTextHandling: wbr-full.png (baked Chinese/English UI) is no longer used; the page chrome, sidebar, comments and document are real DOM in Persian. Only the avatar initial V remains Latin.
concerns: The title close-up (frames 0-22) crops the right end of the brand text, as the original close-up crops its page; intentional.
Persian copy was condensed (long clauses dropped) to keep original one/two-line block geometry so wipes, carets and the wash line up.
lessons: Mock documents with fixed block geometry (wipe masks keyed to layout JSON): Persian text is wider/wraps differently; a bullet that wraps overlaps the next block, so fit-check every block against its original line count and shorten copy rather than letting it wrap.
Baked screenshot textures with foreign UI text: rebuild as DOM driven by the same layout JSON so animations keep their geometry.
